about: The 20 CODIS core STR loci: names (the digits are part of the name: chromosome and segment), not data. A chapter may set them on screen as labels; their repeat counts are data and must trace to the text like any number. yLoci: the 27 Y-STR loci of the Yfiler Plus kit (the 27 the Baiyin case compared).
source: FBI, CODIS and NDIS Fact Sheet: the 20 CODIS core loci (https://www.fbi.gov/how-we-can-help-you/dna-fingerprint-act-of-2005-expungement-policy/codis-and-ndis-fact-sheet)
ySource: Thermo Fisher, Applied Biosystems Yfiler Plus PCR Amplification Kit: 27 Y-STR loci (https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/4484678)
